title: P0 — three remaining live-operations defects: orphan execution capacity leak, empty DSH fallback route boot crash, 0/0 objective budget misclassification
description: F1: non-terminal executor_execution rows under terminal missions were never reconciled (planRestartRecovery scans only NON-terminal missions; abort legitimately leaves in-flight work unresolved) and consumed router/registry capacity forever — observed live (2 RUNNING orphans under FAILED missions → CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED after restart). ReconciliationService.settleTerminalMissionOrphans() (sole settlement authority) reconciles orphans via the canonical proof and durably settles CONFIRMED_* outcomes through terminal_outcome+settled_receipt_id (EXECUTION_ORPHAN_SETTLED event); CONFIRMED_RUNNING/UNKNOWN_SIDE_EFFECT_STATE stay reserved and re-probe on a bounded orphan_recheck_after cadence; operator acknowledgment still releases. Invoked from supervisor.resume() and tick(). Capacity counters honor terminal_outcome + canonical TIMEOUT. F2: PAIR_DSH_FALLBACK_ROUTE="" inserted an invalid "" candidate that crashed boot at strict route resolution. New composeConfiguredRoleRoutes() treats empty/whitespace as disabled, dedupes preserving order, keeps malformed non-empty candidates for fail-closed resolution; planner unchanged. F3: default ceiling=0 misclassified OBJECTIVE_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED (0>=0). Canonical budgetView contract: ceiling<=0 is ZERO_BUDGET hard bound, never uncapped. New OBJECTIVE_ZERO_BUDGET outcome at all admission gates + proveDispatchAuthority; scheduler continues it as BUDGET_OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED; ledger gate unchanged — zero budget never authorizes spend.
